---
title: "Internal CEDER Map"

---

```{r, include=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(mapview)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE)
```

```{r}
#load spatial data
states <- readRDS(r"(R:\Epi-Division\City Health Dashboard\Analyses for communications\CEDER\Outputted files\states_sf.RDS)")
cities <- readRDS(r"(R:\Epi-Division\City Health Dashboard\Analyses for communications\CEDER\Outputted files\ceder_centroids.RDS)")

#load functions
load(r"(R:\Epi-Division\City Health Dashboard\Analyses for communications\CEDER\Outputted files\CEDER_map_function.RData)")

```

```{r, out.width= '100%'}
ceder_map(state_sf = states, 
          city_sf = cities, 
          shift_geos = F,
          title=F)
```
